list: The official PS5 trophy list: 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 of them hidden on PlayStation until earned. Every name, description and grade below is shown exactly as PlayStation publishes it; the guide beside each trophy is written for this atlas and cites its sources.

roadmap.title: Chapter 1 — Touch Down in Leonida
roadmap.text: Play the opening missions (Gone Fishing first) and enjoy the story — every story trophy pops on its own and none can be missed. Do the one risky thing in this phase: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia is at Jason's house in the morning and says she is going to meditate; follow her to the balcony and choose Accept, because that first meditation may count toward Positive Mental Attitude and is gone when Chapter 1 ends. Start the habits that pay off later: scan every new vehicle (Whip It Good), WAiNK every new spot (You WAiNKer!), and keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — the game has no mission replay. Cal's fishing strand opens after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
watch: Positive Mental Attitude — the Chapter 1 balcony meditation

roadmap.title: Chapters 2–3 — Build the Empire
roadmap.time: On the way through the story
roadmap.text: Trust (Breakfast Run) lands in Chapter 2 and Break the Bank (The Cartel Heist) in Chapter 3, with the chapter trophies Paradise Lost and T**s Ass Drug Money closing out their chapters. Keep scanning vehicles and register keepers to the Scooter Bros app as you find them (On the Spot). Optional missions with black icons can expire, but none of them is tied to a trophy, so play what looks fun and move on.

roadmap.title: Chapters 4–5 — The Endgame Story
roadmap.text: Chapter 4 brings Family Matters (Child's Play), DWNFALL (Headliners) and Hi-Jacked (VCIA Takedown); Chapter 5 brings Snow Storm (Operation Savage Glory) and the final mission (You Gotta Know When to Get Off). Drop a manual save before the final mission. When the credits end you are back in free-roam with every trophy quest giver available again — nothing on the 100% checklist is missable.

roadmap.title: The 100% Grind — A Long Road
roadmap.text: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist — it asks for roughly 60% of everything, not all of it. This phase carries most trophies with it: The Shootist (all 42 shooting-range golds), Top Fun (a win at all 14 drone locations), Cunning Stunts (250 for the trophy; the checklist wants 300), One Last Thing (50 challenges for the trophy; 70 for the checklist), Maximum Withdrawal (5 of 8 bank vaults; all 8 for the checklist), Pest Control (one Illegal Operation per gang), Don't Touch My Deck and You WAiNKer! for collectibles, The Goodtime State by unfogging the map from a plane, the one-off moments (Sneakthief, Challenging Tank, Catch Me If You Can, In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Let's Go Bowling) and the money trophies (Dime on the Dollar, Treat Yo Self, Little Boxes).

roadmap.title: Strangers, Freaks & the Platinum
roadmap.text: Strangers & Freaks strands are not on the 100% checklist, so finish them here: the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (their strands also count toward the 8 needed for Strangers & Freaks), Bret's hunting strand for Fair Game, and any meditations still open for Positive Mental Attitude. Sweep up leftover misc trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Gunslinger, Personal Best, Actions Speak Louder), and when the 54th trophy lands, Vice Got a Price! pops on its own. Estimated total: about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10 (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing separate to do. Every trophy in the game is offline and single-player, so one thorough playthrough plus the cleanup phases of the roadmap is enough. Work the phases in order and this is the last thing that unlocks.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening main mission of Chapter 1, and this pops automatically. It cannot be missed: the game has no mission replay, and story trophies simply unlock in sequence as you play. A natural first trophy of the run.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 1; players report it actually pops after What's in the Bag?, the first main mission of Chapter 2. It is a straight story reward and cannot be missed, so just keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2; the trophy is reported to pop after Welcome to Vice City, the first main mission of Chapter 3. Pure story progression — nothing optional is tied to it and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3; reported to pop after Ocean Beach and Another Life, the first two main missions of Chapter 4. Keep following the main mission markers and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4; it pops after Starting From Zero, the chapter's last main mission. A pure story reward that cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final main mission of Chapter 5. Drop a manual save before you start it — the game has no mission replay — although the trophy itself is a guaranteed story unlock, and free-roam continues afterwards for the cleanup phases.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a main mission in Chapter 2. It pops as part of normal story progression and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a main mission in Chapter 3. It unlocks as you play the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a main mission in Chapter 4. A guaranteed story unlock; nothing optional feeds into it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a main mission in Chapter 4. It pops through normal story progression and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a main mission in Chapter 4. A straight story reward — play the mission and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a main mission in Chapter 5. The last of the named story-mission trophies, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion on the checklist at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, which only appears after the final mission — though everything you do earlier already counts toward it. The checklist asks for much less than everything (roughly 60% of the game's content): set robbery quotas, 70 of the 80 challenges, and partial collectibles. It is the longest grind of the platinum and the trophy most players finish last.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts, mixed freely across the stunt categories: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 BASE jumps — 397 exist in total. The 100% checklist wants 300, so work past the trophy if you are chasing A Long Road. Track the running count under Progress.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — races, shooting ranges, drone races, fishing, arcade games and the rest. Progress is listed under Progress > Activities, so use that screen as your checklist and sample whatever you have not touched yet.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Learn each range's target patterns and retry freely; the ranges are also required by the 100% checklist, so this doubles as completion progress.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 races exist in all, but one win per location is enough for the trophy. Drone races are also on the 100% checklist, so nothing here is wasted effort.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win any 20 of the 40 unique races. Pick the shorter street races first and reuse a fast, upgraded car; a win only counts once per unique race, so keep moving to new events instead of farming a favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts you and a purple fishing marker appears — follow his fishing questline from there until the head-to-head challenge against him opens, then out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game: reach the end of any of the 4 video games, clearing every level once. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and treat it as a single sitting.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy: finish his five quests as Lucia, ending with Puff Puff Pass. If Andy goes quiet mid-story, do not worry — trophy quest givers return, and he is still available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton by clearing all 7 shipwrecks in his Kenton's Treasures questline. Kenton becomes unavailable for part of the story, but he returns — every character tied to a trophy is still there after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy: finish his five quests, ending with Hometown Heroes. His strand can be done during the story or safely left for the post-story cleanup phase.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. These strands are NOT on the 100% checklist, so they are easy to forget: the strands tied to Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone count toward the eight, and strangers met in the open world remain available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy by delivering all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List. Source each listed car and deliver it in good condition; the strand finishes once the last car is handed over.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone: as Jason, destroy the Kitty Litter Labs, then finish the mission Spin on This. Follow his strand to its end whenever it opens up.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, cannot be repeated once Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the one risky trophy of the run: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia at Jason's house says in the morning that she is going to meditate — follow her to the balcony and choose Accept, because that first meditation adds to the counter, is not marked as a normal spot, and cannot be repeated once Chapter 1 ends. Whether the trophy strictly needs it is unconfirmed, so do it to be safe; the other 17 spots stay available all game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret: work through Bret Vogel's hunting questline as Jason, starting with Veteran Hunted. The exact animal that triggers the trophy is not confirmed, so finish his whole strand rather than stopping early. Studying animals through the binoculars along the way also feeds the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets. Pick three short sets for the trophy itself; KeenGamer's roadmap lists 15 completed sets among the 100% collectible objectives, so keep collecting afterwards if you are chasing A Long Road.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations — there are more than 100 in the game, so you can skip the awkward ones. Make it a habit early: scan whenever the app pings a new spot and this finishes long before the endgame.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this trophy should pop on its own during the completion grind — check Progress to see which of your challenges are closest to done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner along (possible from the Coffee Break point of the story onward), reach a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose it by getting fully out of the red heat zone — merely reaching the flashing search phase is not enough. Stay mobile, break line of sight, and keep moving until the stars drain completely.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without ever losing your Wanted Level — keep the wanted level alive between stores instead of hiding, and the trophy pops about half a minute after the third robbery. Pick three nearby shops and a fast car before you start.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — driving them is not required. There are 557 vehicles in the game, so scan everything new you pass from the very start and this lands early; vehicle scans also feed the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Line the group up first — a gang operation is ideal — then trigger Focus and drop five before it ends. Soldiers, police and civilians reportedly do not count, so use gang or criminal targets.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport): steal a passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge and fly it about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. Expect a wanted level — just keep flying until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The hidden description ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos') points at the Rhino tank: steal one from Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County and shoot some enemies with it. Getting away afterwards is optional — the kills with the tank are what count.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs open the way, enter a jewelry store's backroom with the Snap Gun, open the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Take it slowly — being detected at any point voids the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape the heat afterwards. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so a player in a hurry can stop at five, while a completionist should simply keep going.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape: blow open the back doors of a large armored truck with Sticky Bombs, grab the cash and lose the heat. The wiki's unlock notes add that robbing a large bank vault also counts toward this one.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: clear the fog from the entire map. A plane is by far the fastest way — fly slow passes over the greyed-out areas, including the far corners and the islands, until no fog remains anywhere.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations exist in total, so you need one per gang, not all of them. Track which gangs you have already hit under Progress so you do not waste runs repeating the same gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach: buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it standing next to the bar. A one-minute trophy once you know the spot.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City using the Key Cloner, then drive it straight out through the window. Expect police attention on the way out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The hidden description names the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, take all 3 key valuables and escape the police. Grab the valuables first, then run — the escape is part of the unlock.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Get Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength at the same time — the 'partnership with mass appeal' is the pair's shared stat grind. Train both characters' Strength through gym and melee activities and keep them balanced, so both are sitting at maximum together.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. The 'choices made' of the hidden description are profile-shifting actions, not a one-time story branch, so this cannot be missed: it accumulates naturally through robberies and mayhem. Check the trend of your profile under Progress.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The trigger is not yet confirmed. Community notes collected by The Games Wiki think it involves the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, so revisit that store later in the game if it has not popped. Because it is unverified, do not plan your run around it — treat it as a bonus unlock and check the cited sources for updates.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO Easter egg near the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2:00 AM — the 'what the hell just happened?' moment. Go at night, trigger the encounter and see it through; the community is still verifying the exact trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The trigger is not confirmed; community notes think it comes from kicking people while riding a motorcycle — a melee drive-by. Try it opportunistically when you pass pedestrians on a bike, but do not grind it until sources confirm the exact requirement.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 in total by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). The bills come from bank and Payday Loans robberies, and the laundering step opens after the mission Credit Check. Keep delivering marked bills after every robbery and the total climbs steadily.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Guns, car mods and tattoos cost the most, so this usually pops during endgame shopping for the completion grind — there is no need to waste money early.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garage properties, $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages are not needed and do not count. Buy them as your money grows — the garages also give your vehicle collection somewhere to live.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you find a vehicle you want to keep, register it on the spot — ten registrations is a small number if you make it a habit from early in the game, alongside scanning for Whip It Good.
